column1: # Erlang/BEAM hold-live: all N processes confirmed alive before memory is
# sampled. Forge copies its process, supervisor, mailbox and
# reduction-budget design from this runtime, so it is the reference the
# Forge concurrency numbers should be read against.
# proc_mem_kb is erlang:memory(processes) -- what the processes themselves
# cost. peak_rss_kb is the whole emulator including its preallocated
# carriers, which is what the other runtimes' maxrss figures measure.
